{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect basic info
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'\nUnique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')

# Check for QA test orders
qa_orders = df[df["revenue"] == "999999.99"]
print(f'\nQA test orders found: {qa_orders.shape[0]}')

# Check refunded orders
refunded = df[df["status"] == "refunded"]
print(f'\nRefunded orders found: {refunded.shape[0]}')"}
